title: Les Snead on Sean McVay: We're in lockstep, work together on these decisions

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Les Snead on Sean McVay: We're in lockstep, work together on these decisions
sources.description: The Rams G.M. said on Friday that he and McVay are collaborative and want to do what's best for the team after selecting QB Ty Simpson on Thursday night.
